# Character Background Before a new character can be finalized you must [bold]set a name and complete the Background page[/bold]. Pressing 'Finalize and Join' saves the character permanently, so choose carefully.
Every choice lists its effects underneath its description. These effects are applied when the character first arrives in the Rift.
## Background Page
### Alignment Your character's moral alignment, from Lawful Good to Chaotic Evil. This serves as a guide for the types of decisions your character might make, and the principles they live by.
### Affiliation This determines which, if any, greater organization (employer, government, etc.). Choosing an option will give you some starting reputation with that group.
## Viewing Your Traits The traits your character has gained can be viewed in the 'Traits' tab of the character menu. Your background choices are tracked as additional traits.
